name: Elonomics
description: Elonomics (ELON) is an Ethereum meme token with an ELON/TSLAon market. A 2% buy and sell hook fee allocates 1% to SPCXon rewards for eligible ELON holders, 0.3% to Programmable, and 0.7% to the developer. Rewards are funded by collected trading fees, converted through available liquidity, and distributed over 24 hours. Rewards vary with trading activity and conversion costs; they are not SpaceX corporate dividends. Elonomics is independent of Elon Musk, Tesla, SpaceX, and Ondo.
